    source: BlueprintSource;
    part_id: string;
};

export type BlueprintSource = {
    kind: "package";
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
} | {
    kind: "draft";
    draft_id: string;
    revision: number;
};

export interface CharacterContent {
    character_id: string;
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
    source: {
        owner_actor_id: string;
        draft_revision: number;
    };
    import_snapshot?: CharacterImportSnapshot;
}

export type CharacterDefaultSelection = {
    layer: "personal";
    selection: PersonalCharacterRef | null;
} | {
    layer: "project";
    selection: ProjectCharacterMemberRef | {
        kind: "assistant";
    } | null;
};

export interface CharacterDraft {
    character_id: string;
    owner_actor_id: string;
    revision: number;
    state: CharacterState;
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
    import_snapshot?: CharacterImportSnapshot;
}

export interface CharacterDraftPatch {
    title: string;
    instructions: string;
    host_tools: string[] | null;
    action_tools?: ExactActionReference[] | null;
}

export interface CharacterImportCandidate {
    candidate_id: string;
    label: string;
    executable: string | null;
    snapshot: CharacterImportSnapshot;
    warnings: string[];
}

export interface CharacterImportFile {
    path: string;
    encoding: "utf8" | "base64";
    content: string;
}

export interface CharacterImportRule {
    path: string;
    scope: "global" | "project";
    content: string;
    condition?: string;
}

export type CharacterImportRuntimeId = typeof CHARACTER_IMPORT_RUNTIMES[number];

export interface CharacterImportSelection {
    rule_paths: string[];
    skill_ids: string[];
}

export interface CharacterImportSkill {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    path: string;
    files: CharacterImportFile[];
    compatibility: "portable" | "native-only";
    reason?: string;
}

export interface CharacterImportSnapshot {
    runtime_id: CharacterImportRuntimeId;
    config_root: string;
    project_root?: string;
    captured_at: string;
    rules: CharacterImportRule[];
    skills: CharacterImportSkill[];
}

export type CharacterRole = {
    layer: "personal";
    state: "active" | "disabled";
    draft_revision: number;
    current: PersonalCharacterVersionRef;
    origin: BlueprintPartOrigin | null;
} | {
    layer: "project";
    state: "active" | "disabled";
    revision: string;
    current: ProjectCharacterVersionRef;
    origin: BlueprintPartOrigin | null;
    sections: Record<CharacterRoleSection, CharacterSectionStatus>;
};

export type CharacterRoleReadInput = {
    queries: CharacterRoleReadQuery[];
};

export type CharacterRoleReadOutput = {
    results: CharacterRoleReadResult[];
};

export type CharacterRoleReadQuery = {
    by: "role";
    role: PersonalCharacterRef | ProjectCharacterMemberRef;
} | {
    by: "request";
    layer: "personal" | "project";
    request_id: string;
};

export type CharacterRoleReadResult = {
    kind: "missing";
} | {
    kind: "role";
    role: CharacterRole;
} | {
    kind: "receipt";
    receipt: CharacterTemplateAdoptionResult;
    current: CharacterRole | null;
};

export type CharacterRoleSection = "work_style" | "capabilities";

export type CharacterRoleVersionRef = PersonalCharacterVersionRef | ProjectCharacterVersionRef;

export type CharacterSectionStatus = {
    mode: "follow";
} | {
    mode: "override";
    based_on_original_version: number;
    original_changed: boolean;
};

export type CharacterState = "active" | "disabled" | "tombstoned";

export type CharacterTaskSelection = PersonalCharacterRef | ProjectCharacterMemberRef | {
    kind: "assistant";
};

export type CharacterTemplateAdoptionResult = {
    outcome: "created" | "reused";
    origin: BlueprintPartOrigin;
    role: CharacterRole;
};

export interface CharactersCommand {
    create(): CharacterDraft;
    update(characterId: string, expectedRevision: number, patch: CharacterDraftPatch): CharacterDraft;
    setState(characterId: string, expectedRevision: number, state: CharacterState): CharacterDraft;
}

export interface CharactersQuery {
    list(): CharacterDraft[];
    get(characterId: string): CharacterDraft | null;
}

export type EffectiveCharacterSelection = {
    kind: "role";
    source: "task";
    version: CharacterRoleVersionRef;
} | {
    kind: "role";
    source: "project";
    version: ProjectCharacterVersionRef;
} | {
    kind: "role";
    source: "personal";
    version: PersonalCharacterVersionRef;
} | {
    kind: "assistant";
    source: "task" | "project";
} | {
    kind: "assistant";
    source: "assistant";
    stopped_project_default?: ProjectCharacterMemberRef;
};

export type PersonalCharacterRef = {
    kind: "personal";
    character_id: string;
};

export type PersonalCharacterVersionRef = PersonalCharacterRef & {
    version: number;
};

export type ProjectCharacterMemberRef = {
    kind: "project";
    member_id: string;
};

export type ProjectCharacterVersionRef = ProjectCharacterMemberRef & {
    member_version: number;
    original: PersonalCharacterVersionRef;
};
